subject: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Acme Media Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer

Hi Amanda / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — appreciate the clarity on your expected monthly usage profile. Before we put the private offer into AWS, a couple of asks so engineering and finance are aligned: 

1) Commit tiers: can you confirm whether Acme prefers a single annual committed $ ARR or quarterly commits? We propose two SKU buckets: "Base (0-200k tokens/mo)" and "Scale (200k+ tokens/mo)" for pricing simplicity.

2) Channel margin: Acme asked about the reseller margin waterfall. Our standard for this deal would be a 14% reseller margin on list price, with an optional performance uplift to 18% if contracted ARR >= $300k. Would that work for you?

3) Invoicing & marketplace visibility: Are you OK with the private offer showing Acme as the subscribing account (common for marketplace POs)? If you prefer an authorative reseller invoice, we can discuss that flow.

4) Evidence needed: procurement asked for SOC2 summary & reseller agreement — attaching SOC2_summary.pdf. We can also supply a short reseller letter if required.

Attached: Acme_MA_RateCard.xlsx (draft pricing buckets).

If helpful, Karthik can outline two concrete pricing options so legal can redline one doc. We’d like to get to PO signature by end of next week to secure the proposed private-offer credits.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Acme_MA_RateCard.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@aws-partners.amazon.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Acme Media Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:04:17 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the summary. A few quick clarifications from the AWS side and from Acme's procurement: 

- Commit cadence: Acme prefers annual financial commitment but needs monthly metering for usage reconciliation. AWS private offer can support an annual commitment with monthly metered settlement — confirming that this aligns with Redwood's billing flow.

- Reseller margin: 14% base sounds reasonable. Acme will push for the 18% uplift if we hit higher consumption bands; can you confirm the concrete redemption criteria (e.g., trailing 3-month average > X)?

- Evidence: Procurement needs a reseller agreement (signed), SOC2 summary (we have that), and a reseller tax/corp certificate. Please attach reseller agreement template and the tax cert if you have one.

- Marketplace UX: Acme's legal prefers the private offer to show Acme as the subscriber for ease of internal cost allocation. Please confirm any impact this has on your revenue recognition and commission timing.

I’ve looped in Acme procurement (procurement@acmemedia.io) on this thread — they may send a PO stub.

Best,
Amanda
Partner GTM Manager — AWS Marketplace
---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Acme Media Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 08:40:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer

Amanda / Acme team — thanks for the fast reply. Long-form options below so legal and procurement have concrete language to review.

Option A (Standard):
- Annual committed ARR via private offer (customer signs PO with AWS private-offer SKU mapping).
- Reseller margin: 14% of Redwood list price.
- Uplift clause: if trailing 3-month consumption >= $25k (net revenue to Redwood) then reseller margin for subsequent quarter increases to 18%.
- Billing: AWS invoices Acme; Redwood invoices AWS / marketplace reconciliation as per AWS terms. Redwood issues reseller commission to Acme on net recognized revenue monthly (30 days after month close).

Option B (Performance-first):
- Higher base commitment (>= $300k ARR) with a stepped margin: 16% base + 2% MDF credit payable as a quarterly rebate tied to marketing activity evidence.
- Faster commission timing: commission paid within 15 days after month close for committed portion.

Requested evidence (to speed internal approvals):
- Signed reseller agreement (we will provide template).
- SOC2_summary.pdf (attached by Kimberly).
- W9/Tax certificate or equivalent for Acme (please attach).

Next steps / MAP:
- Kimberly to provide reseller template + DocuSign link for signature.
- Acme to confirm preferred option and provide PO stub by 2027-04-05.
- Amanda to confirm AWS private-offer mapping semantics and whether subscriber view will show Acme (expects yes).

HubSpot: added note to deal R-INF-2027-0142 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/56231).

-Karthik
Senior Sales Manager, Cloud Marketplace
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: Proposed_commission_table.csv (inline summary)
From: Acme Media Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@aws-partners.amazon.com>, Acme Media - Legal <legal@acmemedia.io>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:22:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer

Kimberly / Karthik,

Thanks for the two options. Procurement prefers Option B with the stepped margin and MDF credit, but a couple of points before we route to legal: 

- Please confirm whether Redwood can issue a separate invoice to Acme (rather than going through AWS) for the reseller commission portion. Our internal allocation needs a line-item from Redwood for rebate accounting.

- We need confirmation that the private offer will render with Acme as the subscriber on the AWS billing console (we will not accept a flow that obfuscates the subscribing account).

- Attached a PO stub for internal reference (Acme_PO_stub.pdf). This is not the signed commitment — legal will still review.

If you can send a short reseller agreement and a sample SLA credit clause for marketplace incidents, we can expedite.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement — Acme Media
---
Attachment: Acme_PO_stub.pdf (pdf, 1 page)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Acme Media Procurement <procurement@acmemedia.io>, Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@aws-partners.amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify commit tiers, reseller split & evidence for AWS private offer

Marta / Amanda,

Appreciate the preference for Option B — that's fine from our side. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Separate invoice: Redwood can issue a separate rebate invoice to Acme for the MDF/commission portion. That invoice will reference the AWS private-offer subscription ID for reconciliation. Finance OK'd 30-day net on rebate invoices; we can shorten to 15 days once the $300k ARR committed threshold is in place.

- Marketplace subscriber view: confirmed — AWS private offer will show Acme as the subscriber in the AWS console. Amanda, please confirm if there are any partner-level visibility caveats; otherwise we'll proceed.

- Attached: reseller_agreement_template.docx and sample_SLA_credit_clause.docx; SOC2_summary.pdf (already attached). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/Acme-R-INF-2027-0142

Next steps:
- Marta: please confirm final PO amount and sign the reseller agreement via DocuSign by 2027-04-05 to lock in the stepped margin.
- Karthik / Sean: I'll schedule a 30-minute wrap-up call for Thursday (time options below).

Times (PST): Thu 2027-04-01 09:00 or 11:00. Let me know which works.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: reseller_agreement_template.docx; sample_SLA_credit_clause.docx; SOC2_summary.pdf
